label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly into SQL ORDER BY clause at line 25 via string concatenation. Although regex validation '[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*' restricts input to alphanumeric+underscore, the resolved sink value still depends on user input. Regex filtering is a mitigation but does not eliminate the fundamental vulnerability of constructing SQL queries from user-supplied data without prepared statements. The sink expression 'SELECT id, name FROM users ORDER BY ' + param receives attacker-controlled data.
